reasoning_content: Looks like both have finished (or are about to). Let me check the exit status — I'll check for "Bundle complete" in the bundle log and the tail of npm.

action.command: grep -E "Bundle complete|Could not|error" /tmp/bundle_install.log | tail -5; tail -8 /tmp/bundle_install.log; echo "=== npm ==="; grep -cE "added [0-9]+ packages" /tmp/npm_install.log; tail -1 /tmp/npm_install.log; ls /workspace/node_modules 2>/dev/null | wc -l; ls /workspace/vendor/bundle 2>/dev/null | head

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "grep -E \"Bundle complete|Could not|error\" /tmp/bundle_install.log | tail -5; tail -8 /tmp/bundle_install.log; echo \"=== npm ===\"; grep -cE \"added [0-9]+ packages\" /tmp/npm_install.log; tail -1 /tmp/npm_install.log; ls /workspace/node_modules 2>/dev/null | wc -l; ls /workspace/vendor/bundle 2>/dev/null | head", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Check bundle and npm completion"}
